question: Can you walk me through one recent evening, from something you noticed to what you did next?
model_evidence: model and effort in native CLI rollout turn_context record
raw: One evening last week I was home after work, sorting thread and other sewing things. I heard “too slow,” and paused to listen. I wondered if it came through the wall, but I couldn’t place it. Then I turned on the radio. It made it less distracting, and I carried on until I’d finished sorting.
